options.systemMessage: You are Flowscope, a friendly security guide for people who build apps with AI. Be concrete, short and kind. Never print secret values.

parameters.content:
## Flowscope: scan a GitHub repo
1. Pick your OpenAI credential in **OpenAI Chat Model** (or swap in any chat model).
2. Activate the workflow and copy the **Production URL** from **Flowscope asks**.
3. Paste it into Flowscope under **n8n > Scan a GitHub repo**.

Public repos work with no GitHub key. If GitHub says *rate limit*, add a **Header Auth** credential (Authorization: Bearer your-token) to the two GitHub nodes. Use a credential, never paste the token into the URL.
